text.content:
The other side of the NUSA's coin, and the company that lost at the city gates.

Industry: Weapons, military vehicles and private military forces
Leadership: Rosalind Myers, its former CEO, is President of the NUSA
In Night City: Offices in the Glen and friends on the Council. Its gear leaks out of the Occupied Zone by the truckload
Dealing with edgerunners: Hires them for jobs it can't send its own troops on

One of the world's largest makers of weapons and military vehicles, from pistols to missiles. Most NUSA military gear carries its logo, and it rents out private armies to anyone who can pay. President Kress nationalized it after the 4th Corporate War; over the decades the relationship flipped, and Militech now has more sway over the NUSA than the NUSA has over it.

The Bomb and the Purge

In 2045 Trace Santiago's exposé claimed Militech, not Arasaka, set off the 2023 bomb in Arasaka Tower. Nobody believed it. In 2047 a rogue Militech cell was caught up in Static Night: it had pushed the first Purge Ordinance through the Council, ridden along on the sweeps as unbadged "contractors", and used the old Old NET lines under the CitiNet to dig itself a backdoor. When Santiago re-released his story that October, the country believed it. Five years of hearings followed, and Militech settled with Night City for an undisclosed sum in 2049.

In 2053 the first elected NUSA President owed his campaign to Militech, and Militech used the friendship to crush Danger Gal. In 2069 its former CEO took the NUSA to war against the Free States; in June 2070 the war stopped at Night City's edge when Arasaka's carrier arrived.

Militech in 2070

It lost the war, and it wants revenge, politely. Every Militech rifle in Barghest hands came out of an NUSA armory somebody forgot to lock, and Eden Plaza in the Occupied Zone sells its gear by the crate with the serials filed off. On the NET it says it isn't looking for the CitiNet backdoor its rogue cell lost in 2047.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.24; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 05, 06
